title: Global identifiability for the staged-infection SIR model
description: Prose proof of Conjecture 1 of Pant, Saucedo and Pogudin (medRxiv v2): for each known number n>=1 of infectious stages and known total population, generic real true points are identifiable against all real competitors from the analytic incidence germ. Includes standard-library finite controls n=1..6, not an all-n mechanical proof. Two-stage AI audit and an editorial MINOR review with corrections addressed; no human peer review or formal certification. Excludes unknown n/N0, finite/noisy data and estimation guarantees. Text/data CC BY 4.0; code Apache 2.0.
